minor.description: Learn 1 spell at level 1, then 1 additional spell every 2 levels.

major.description: Learn 1 spell at level 1, then 1 additional spell every level.

intModifierSpells.description: After each rest, choose additional known spells equal to INT modifier. Changeable each rest.
intModifierSpells.minorRestrictions: Cannot learn 5th level spells from INT mod. Max 2 spells of same level (except 1st).
intModifierSpells.majorRestrictions: Max 1 spell of each level from INT mod (except 1st).

concentrationSaveDC.description: WILL saving throw. DC = 5 + attacker's might.
